channel.title: Shuvam Banerji Seal, blog
channel.description: Information retrieval, quantum chemistry, molecular simulation and scientific software.

item.title: AgriIR, a configurable RAG pipeline for agricultural questions
item.description: How AgriIR answers agricultural questions with small open models in six configurable stages, attaches citations deterministically, and how it was evaluated.

item.title: BM25, explained through this site's search box
item.description: How BM25 scores a document, term by term: saturation with k1, length normalisation with b, a never-negative IDF, and a worked example by hand.

item.title: Drawing benzene's π orbitals from Hückel theory
item.description: How the benzene figure on the homepage is made: Hückel π orbitals, Slater 2p functions, and points sampled from the probability density, coloured by sign.

item.title: Hybrid search with BM25, dense embeddings and reciprocal rank fusion
item.description: Why a RAG system should run keyword and embedding search side by side, and how reciprocal rank fusion merges them without calibrating scores.

item.title: Kohn–Sham DFT on one page
item.description: The chain of ideas behind a DFT calculation, from Born–Oppenheimer and the Hohenberg–Kohn theorems to the Kohn–Sham equations, functionals and basis sets.

item.title: Molecule3D: a LAMMPS workbench that runs in your browser
item.description: What Molecule3D (LAMMPS Web GUI) does, who it is for, and what a first session looks like, from a starter script to a trajectory and its RDF.

item.title: Reading an MD trajectory: radial distribution function and mean squared displacement
item.description: How to compute g(r) and the mean squared displacement from a periodic MD trajectory, with a short numpy implementation tested on cases with known answers.

item.title: Sycophancy in LLMs, and why we test it on court cases
item.description: What sycophancy in language models is, why legal reasoning exposes it sharply, and how the SycoLex benchmark measures it with paired, opposite prompts.

item.title: Tip-of-the-tongue search at TREC 2024, with BM25 and rewritten queries
item.description: How our TREC 2024 Tip-of-the-Tongue runs rewrote vague queries with an LLM in four phases and used layered BM25 retrieval to reach Recall@1000 of 0.8067.
